❯ Measure the 2.4 release candidate's page load times.

⏺ 2.4 vs 2.3: product page largest contentful paint 2.9 s -> 1.8 s, checkout 3.4 s -> 3.6 s
  (slightly worse: the new payment widget loads a 400 KB script). Under 2.5 s is
  Google's 'good' threshold, which affects search ranking; checkout is above it in both.
